description: Implementation of CustomerOption Data Access Object (DAO) with methods for listing, retrieving by ID or code, and saving/updating CustomerOption entities. Uses QueryDSL for building JPQL queries, integrates with Spring's @Repository annotation.

classes.name: CustomerOptionDaoImpl
classes.description: Repository implementation for CustomerOption entity providing data retrieval and persistence methods.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of CustomerOption entities associated with a specific store and language, using JPQL query with joins and fetches.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOption entity by its unique ID, with its descriptions and associated store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a CustomerOption by its code within a specific store, including descriptions.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerOption or updates an existing one; throws ServiceException if operation fails.
